title: Authenticator
empty_body: Add an account to generate 6-digit verification codes. Paste an otpauth:// link (from the site’s QR) or the secret key.
privacy_note: 🔒 All local. Codes are computed in the browser (no secret leaves the device). Keys are stored on the Cardputer’s SD, protected by pairing: revoke sessions in Settings if you lose a device.
add_sub: Paste the otpauth:// link (from the QR) — it fills everything. Or enter the fields by hand.
confirm_del: Delete the "{name}" account? Its 2FA key will be removed from this device.
err_device: Cardputer unreachable — nothing was saved. Try again shortly.
err_unpaired: This browser isn't paired with the Cardputer — pair it to save accounts.
offline_banner: Codes from this browser's last copy: the Cardputer isn't answering, so changes are paused.
err_hotp: HOTP (counter-based) accounts aren't supported — use a TOTP (time-based) account.
err_algo: SHA-512 isn't supported — this account would produce wrong codes.
